description.fun: Golett were moulded from clay and brought to life by the science of an ancient civilisation thousands of years ago to labour for their makers, and they still follow those long-ago orders today. Nobody knows what powers them, and it may soon run out. For unknown reasons, some are driven to keep lining up boulders. Designed by James Turner, the line draws on golems from Jewish folklore and perhaps Japan's clay haniwa figures.
description.guide: Golett is a Ground- and Ghost-type Pokémon made of clay by an ancient civilisation and powered by a mysterious energy. It evolves into Golurk.
description.tagline: An ancient clay robot still following orders after thousands of years.

description.fun: Golurk were built by ancient people to protect people and Pokémon, and they follow their masters faithfully. Tucking in its limbs, it blasts through the sky at Mach speed, and it can even become a cannon: ancient castle walls had platforms for Golurk to fire from. The seal on its chest holds in its unstable energy, and if it's removed, Golurk rampages until a whole town is rubble, an echo of the Golem of Prague legend.
description.guide: Golurk is the evolved form of Golett, a Ground- and Ghost-type Pokémon built in ancient times to protect people and Pokémon. The seal on its chest keeps its energy in check. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Golurk.
description.tagline: A clay guardian that flies like a rocket and must stay sealed.

description.fun: Mega Evolution stirs up its energy so much that the seal on its chest can no longer hold it and dangles uselessly from one screw. Wrapped in a blazing glow, it could explode at any moment, and it fires its own fists like rockets before they fly back to its arms.
